record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose these five. They are the records of what was learned or corrected, and none has another home; decisions, evidence, and phases already have their own views.

## Counter-argument

Including failed checks and upstream assessments would make the journal the one place that tells the whole story of a repair.

payload.alternatives: also decisions, upstream assessments, failed check-runs and reports, integration reports, or phase transitions
payload.choice: The journal shows failed attempts (marked don't retry), investigation observations, findings, continuity questions, and assignment amendments
